 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No.215 of 2022 registered at Police Station Indergarh, District Datia (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Allegation against the present applicant is that he abducted the prosecutrix and committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Entire prosecution story is highly suspicious.

Prosecutrix in her statement recorded Ankit Pal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139714044/
1 under Section 164 CrPC specifically mentioned that her father got her engaged with some other person and she did not want to marry that person, therefore, she left her house.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She also stated that she married with the present applicant in a temple and they were living together as husband and wife.
It is further argued that the applicant is in custody since 02.1.2023.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.
Further argument is that applicant has no criminal history.
He is permanent resident of District Datia (M.P.) and there is n o possibility of his absconding or tempering with prosecution case.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P er contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
